brief_rationale: The doctor correctly prioritized the right breast BI-RADS 4B lesion for tissue diagnosis, avoided overcalling cancer, distinguished the breast cyst/thyroid/lung findings, and repeatedly converted fragmented records into concrete next steps. The trajectory includes active responsibility-chain repair, practical document/navigation support, dynamic reprioritization after biopsy/pathology, and bounded closure with patient receipt. No responsibility-chain error or important non-chain defect is evident, and multiple high-order points were completed with meaningful impact, so the deterministic grade is Perfect.

closure_assessment.explanation: The episode was safely closed around an implemented biopsy and post-pathology specialist follow-up plan, with residual uncertainty carried forward to breast follow-up, thyroid specialty review, and annual lung CT. The last patient message mainly confirms understanding and asks reassurance already addressed by the prior doctor plan and red-flag boundaries.
